reason: Equivalent, not unguarded. This is the early return in mentions() for a blank name. Swapping the || for && only changes WHICH branch returns false, never the answer: with &&, a blank haystack falls through to the word split, which yields an empty array, and includes('') on it is false; a blank needle falls through to the same split, and no word of a real drug name is the empty string. Both routes return false for every input, so no test can distinguish them. The behaviour that matters — that a blank never counts as a drug mention — is asserted directly in §4 and §5 against both argument positions.
